title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Maruzensky…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Claw machines! These are so huge with the kids right now.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I used to play them all the time… But once I got the hang of it, the thrill was gone!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, look over there! That plushie is mad cute!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I turn to see Umamusume plushies on display as prizes for a claw machine.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I want that one so bad! Can you get it for me?
choice_data_list: Didn't you say you were good at claw machines?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You just don't get it, Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You just don't get it, Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Having someone win it for you feels totally different from winning it for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You got this, Trainer! I know you can do it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
